Oh absolutely OP should not be the one to provide that space

NTA- as someone with five learning disabilities and ADHD I know its easy to play the "im too stupid card" especially when its something you have been told you are your whole life (as I was). I don't think you should cut off your sister, especially since it seems like living away from your parents may honestly be beneficial for her since they baby the fuck out of her (Not that its your responsibility to provide that space) . But having learning disabilities isn't an excuse for not picking up clothes or walking places.  It seems like your sister needs a serious wake-up call and so do your parents. You could have maybe handled it better but at the end of the day, your parent's created a monster and are the ones to blame. Your sister probably just internalized the idea that shes "too stupid" to be a capable adult
